# Each case is a name, a tab, and a command line; the | marks the cursor, which is always at the
# end (a trailing space would not survive an editor). A third field, unordered, marks a case
# whose candidates a shell reads from a directory, in the file system's order; the test sorts
# them. Every shell's driver completes every case, and want/<shell>.txt holds what each one
# offered.
commands	app |
command-prefix	app re|
flags	app -|
flag-set-left-out	app --format json --|
negated	app --no-|
enum-declared-order	app --level |
enum	app --format |
enum-inline	app --format=|
enum-ignore-case	app --speed S|
enum-ignore-case-inline	app --speed=s|
file-extensions	app --config |	unordered
directory	app --dir |	unordered
none-with-message	app --token |
executable	app --exec rotini-|
user	app --user rotini|
group	app --group rotini|
host	app --host rotini-|
map-keys	app --set |
help-command	app help |
help-command-deep	app help remote |
completer	app deploy |
required-first	app deploy -|
group-left-out	app deploy --quiet -|
sub-command-enum	app deploy --env |
fallback-extensions	app deploy ./|	unordered
fallback-directory	app deploy s|	unordered
fallback-with-candidates	app deploy d|	unordered
fallback-none	app deploy b|
fallback-file	app deploy c|	unordered
quote-all	app quote --odd |
quote-shared	app quote --pair x|
quote-typed-quote	app quote --odd 'it|
quote-typed-quote-shared	app quote --pair 'x|
quote-typed-backslash	app quote --odd it\'|
quote-colon	app quote --addr host:|
quote-inline	app quote --odd=x|
plain-value	app quote --note |	unordered
file-one-extension	app --log sub/|	unordered
file-short-inline	app -l=sub/|	unordered
file-inline	app --config=|	unordered
file-word-break	app --config sub/x:|	unordered
directory-inline	app --dir=|	unordered
directory-no-subdirectories	app --dir sub/|	unordered
user-inline	app --user=rotini|
group-inline	app --group=rotini|
at-file	app --token @|	unordered
at-file-inline	app --token=@|	unordered
at-file-directory	app --token @sub/|	unordered
list-item	app --tag blue,|
program-path	./bin/old/app |
directory-unique	app --dir sr|	unordered
path-type-file	app quote --input |	unordered
path-type-directory	app quote --root |	unordered
